question: On which river is the Tehri dam constructed?
solution:
The correct answer is __Bhagirathi__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Tehri Dam is the highest dam in India.
 
• It has been constructed near Tehri, Uttrakhand.
 
• Tehri Dam is a multi-purpose rock and earth-fill embankment dam.
 
• Bhagirathi river is considered as the source stream of the Holy river Ganges.
 
• The Tehri Dam is an embankment, earth and rock-fill, it retains a reservoir for the generation of 1,000 megawatts of hydroelectricity, irrigation and municipal water supply.
 
• The height of the dam is 260.5 m, length 575 m, and width (crest) 20 m.
 
• It is located near Tehri district in the Uttarakhand state of India. It started operations in 2006.
 
• Gaumukh at Gangotri glacier in the Garhwal Himalaya is the headwaters of Bhagirathi River.
 
• Maneri Dam, Joshiyara (Bhali) Dam, and Koteshwar Dam are some other important dams in the Bhagirathi River.
